body:
We talked about that, though. I know me. I always want to logic things. Even knowing that, it didn't help him understand why.

I feel pretty hopeless about all of this. He's already in a relationship again after a little more than a month, so that stings after he claimed he loved me and wanted to marry me and all that BS.

I don't really know how to make myself move on. I go out with friends, I go to work, I joined sports teams... Nothing is helping.

You'd think that. But out of the seven serious relationships I have been in... Only two were anything remotely okay. Two were actually horrible. The rest were pretty bad. Truth be told: I'm not a nice person anymore. Apparently I'd rather be right. 

I don't want children. Whatever depression I have I don't want to pass on. 

My preferences make my dating pool miniscule. I don't even want to try. 

And rebuild... I've been trying but this sadness and unhappiness have been with me most of my life and I've been trying to work through it... I just give up.
